# requires: wire
#
# `Content-Range: bytes 40-63/*` is legal and says the server will not commit to
# a length. The bytes are right; the only question is what an implementation
# writes into the progress a person is watching, and whether an unparsed `*`
# becomes a zero, a negative, or a total smaller than the work already done.
submit A size=64 digest=good src=http:star
claim A alpha 5000
stage A 40
progress A alpha 40 {"verified_prefix":40}
release A alpha
run A beta
state A

# expect 6: ok state=transferred
# expect 6: done=64 err=none
